[SWS_CORE_03313] Replacement with implicit StringView
⌈
A member
function shall be defined for BasicString that allows replacement of a subsequence
of *this with the contents of any type that is implicitly convertible to StringView:
template <typename T>
BasicString& replace(size_type pos1, size_type n1, T const& t,
size_type pos2, size_type n2 = npos);
This function shall behave the same as the corresponding std::basic_string func-
tion from [6, the C++17 standard].
⌋
